email.subject: AI for Bryant Rabbino LLP, built for transactional practices
email.body:
Hi Seth,

Your work on the $4.55 billion green bond offering for JFK New Terminal One reflects exactly the kind of sophisticated capital markets work that demands precision without compromise. That's where most firms struggle to scale.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to show how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping transactional teams compete with BigLaw on turnaround and quality.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
